hook: San Francisco AI lab Anthropic just banned cruel behavior toward its Claude model.

sections.voiceover: San Francisco AI lab Anthropic just banned cruel behavior toward its Claude model.
Anthropic updated its usage policy on Thursday to ban sustained and needless abuse. The rules go into effect on November 12. Are we entering an era of machine welfare?
Reason journalist Billy Binion noted standard rules like deceptive activity share space with this update.
Pascal Schuster's analysis on Quants & Qualia showed a major shift in focus. Anthropic shifted its explicit purpose from helping users stay safe to preventing real-world harm.
Anthropic updated its usage policy for Claude.
